engagement.title: Choose your level of engagement
engagement.blurb: No matter the scope of your work, Esri professional GIS consultants can help at the level that meets your needs.

projects.title: Projects
paragraphs: Our project work provides comprehensive industry, domain, and technical expertise to address real-world needs. Our experts manage a project's scope, schedule, and budget and use proven methodologies to deliver turnkey systems and applications.
We can consult with you to define the approach to delivering transformational GIS capabilities for your organization.

services.title: Business and Technical Consulting Services
services.description: We offer consulting across multiple business and technical domains depending on what you need and at what level of your organization. Our consultants work directly with you to provide organizational or technical enablement, technical or business strategy.

cards.title: Business consulting
cards.desc: Industry subject-matter expertise that can help incorporate GIS into your overall business strategy, or provide advice on project planning.

cards.title: Enterprise consulting
cards.desc: Experienced consultants who can advise and guide your enterprise GIS strategy and implementation approach.

cards.title: Configuration consulting
cards.desc: ArcGIS installation and configuration specialists providing focused services to enable your teams to get it right the first time.

cards.title: Rent-a-Tech consulting
cards.desc: Highly skilled technical specialists—app developers, geodata engineers, geospatial analysts, and more—working alongside your team to help you succeed.
